title: Reading candidate split scores
description: You can follow the supplied change-point scaffold from slices to normalized weights.

steps.description: The helper calculates a score from a segment's length, mean and supplied variance parameters. You return the expression labeled as log evidence in the scaffold.
posterior_tau considers each split from 1 through T minus 1. You score the left and right slices and append their sum.

steps.question: What does the code divide the exponentiated scores by?
steps.answer: It divides by their sum, making the returned weights sum to one.

steps.description: You concatenate two generated segments and request the highest-weight split, with one added to its array index. The capped recording stops before any final split value is printed.
